g.text: a Generalization to each completely held-out fire family
All ten families · seven models · five seeds · 350 complete audited runs
Prespecified paired differences: 95% geometry-and-seed intervals; positive favors the second model
† Smoldering: 86/97 cases are restored flat responses; 11 retained cases are nonflat.
Intervals are unadjusted; the two cross-family averages are descriptive, with no pooled interval.
